This can lead to feelings of helplessness and isolation. In extreme cases, persistent harassment can contribute to depression, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), and even suicidal ideation. The insidious nature of the attacks, coupled with the difficulty in identifying and stopping the perpetrators, creates a uniquely damaging experience.

Addressing this issue requires a multi-faceted approach, including improved verification methods on social media platforms, stricter enforcement of anti-harassment policies, and increased public awareness of the risks.
